description:
At call resolution (resolve_function_call, jobs/semantic.rs), when the callee's entry dispatch leaves exactly one clause reachable for the argument types with no run-time test, and that clause only passes its parameters in order to an extern, the call resolves to the extern. No activation of the forwarding function is keyed for those types.

Measured by spike on PR 600 (patch: scratch select/spike-select.patch; results on fz-sc8.212), distiller: jobs 12,824 -> 12,505 (-2.5%), executables 1,370 -> 1,280 (-90), fz2 build instructions -0.8 to -1.3% over four pairs, run instructions within 0.07%, stdout identical. 209 call sites selected.

To settle before building (the spike did not): (1) the lowered tail still names the function, so static call edges, demand and transport still read the forwarder: decide where the resolved target is recorded so one fact answers it. (2) The protocol path (semantic.rs ~2094) calls prepare_function_call directly; String.Chars.{Float,Integer}.to_string forwarders remain. If that path takes the same selection, BackendExecutable::forwards_to and the forwarder branch of spliced_extern can be deleted (the splice test becomes 'the callee is an extern'); if not, they stay and this ticket says so. (3) AnalyzeActivation +8 and DeriveRecursive +12 jobs: trace the cause. (4) 41 of the 90 removed executables are not forwarders: account for them. (5) One lambda forwarder remains (OptionParser.validated_kinds): trace its route.

Signal: the spike's figures reproduced on the real change; distiller stdout identical on interp, run and build against elixir; full gate; falling pins listed. Walkthrough to the user before build.

Widened (user-approved 2026-11-25; proposed by Make Distiller Fast). A clause that only passes its parameters, in any order, to one callee resolves to that callee. The callee may be an extern or a function.
Evidence (fz-4hl, fz-distill-hunt/4hl/table.txt): #904 made Map.put/3 a one-clause wrapper that reorders its arguments into :maps.put/3. In the distiller, Map.put's 11 activations and 6 executables are now matched one to one by :maps.put's. The put layer alone costs +164 largest drive and requests, -70 derivations' worth, and 720 reads, about 80% of #904's +204/+141/+937. lib has 10 one-line delegations to Erlang modules of this shape, with more arriving as fz-mue ports land; #881 and #904 both raised pins this way.
Done when: a reordering one-clause delegation costs no second activation, analysis or executable per specialization, and the distiller ceilings are lowered by the measured amount.
title: A clause that only passes its parameters, in any order, to one callee resolves to that callee
